text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races 
alongside Manhattan Cafe――
(Whoooosh......!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... the wind blew something over 
here. This is...

When I picked up the paper that had fallen 
on the street... it looked familiar.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's... the hot springs trip ticket I 
won at the raffle that day...

Everything was a mystery. How could the 
tickets that were supposed to be kept safe 
have...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is terrible... If you don't 
use that hot springs trip ticket soon...

Is something going to happen? Could it be 
an ominous sign...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's almost... reaching its expiration 
date...

...Reality is catching up fast. I took 
some time off in a hurry and decided to 
go.
In the bath...

"Manhattan Cafe hasn't come out of the 
bath for quite a while. Just as I start to 
worry..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... In the hot springs...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "Friend"... has drowned...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"She sank right into the hot spring... It 
seemed like she wasn't very used to 
them..."

It can't be helped if you're not used to 
it. Still, to think you'd sink...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I don't think she needs to breathe, 
and... she was waving as she sank, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Still... I feel a little insecure. You 
were always... by my side, after all..."

Manhattan Cafe looked anxious. As I stood 
there at a loss, unable to do anything—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... You are like a "friend" too... 
aren't you...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Just for today... would you take the place 
of my "friend" in this room?

Nodding quietly, I decided to play the 
role of her imaginary "friend."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... The food is delicious...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Do you want some too...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Is that edible?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You're right... She never... eats, after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Then can I eat it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Do you want to eat?

It was very difficult to hold back my 
appetite and play an inhuman creature.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Never mind, it's fine. You're 
not a "friend" of mine anyway...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“Still... I'm starting to feel like it's 
okay even if we aren't 'friends'...”

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
When I'm with you... it's a different kind 
of fun...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If only we could talk about more things...

Relieved of my duties, I feel a bit more 
at ease. From here on, I can just be 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Trainer-san... Listen closely. Look, 
outside the window...
choice_data_list: Can you hear the bugs chirping?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... the sound of something crawling up 
from the bottom of the water...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Friend"... seems to have come out. They 
are coming this way...
(Drip, drip, drip...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, it's almost here... Look... right 
now, through the window...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What should the three of us do... from 
here?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's all right... After all, the night is 
long...

I frantically pulled a floor cushion over 
my head. After that— I don't remember what 
happened.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between Manhattan Cafe 
and myself...
